Referred to Commandant, S.V.C. for information.
（批：... C.S.P.）
Shanghai Municipal Council.
I. O. REG
No 253
Date 16/4/1927
April 8th 1927.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
Between 3 and 5 a.m. 8th instant two contingents of troops arrived at Markham Road "siding" from the North. These contingents appear to consist of 1,000 infantry, 200 cavalry and a machine gun corps of 100 men. The troops are in uniform but have no rifles. They brought about 100 horses and about 10 machine guns with them. It is reported that the Chapel Authorities have arranged to have the troops temporarily encamped on some vacant ground near the Chapel Public Works if he do not move the arsenal to Jenifield

There is a report to the effect that the rebels held a meeting yesterday for the purpose of discussing ways and means to raise funds. It is said that Chen Chi Mei, Nyeu Tih Sung, 鈕鈺生 and Pah Vung Wei 柏文蔚 attended.

Nyou Tih Sung is now in supreme command of the rebels and they claim that he will lead an attack on the Arsenal in the near future. They believe that General Yang favours their cause. They only fear the opposition of Deputy Military Governor Lu.

The rebels are short of arms and ammunition so they are trying to buy over the police to assist them when they attack the Arsenal.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

（批：...）
Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。
I. O. REG
第 253 号
日期 1927年4月16日
1927年4月8日。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

先生，
本月8日凌晨3时至5时之间，两支部队从北方抵达马克姆路（Markham Road）侧线。这些部队似乎由1000名步兵、200名骑兵和一支100人的机枪队组成。士兵身着制服，但未携带步枪。他们带来了约100匹马和约10挺机枪。据报，若兵工厂不迁至仁记洋行堆栈（Jenifield），教堂当局已安排将该部队暂时驻扎在教堂工务局附近的一块空地上。

有报告称，反叛者昨日举行会议，讨论筹集资金的方法与途径。据说陈其美、钮惕生、鈕鈺生和柏文蔚出席了会议。

钮惕生目前担任反叛者的最高指挥官，他们声称他将在不久的将来率领对兵工厂的进攻。他们认为杨将军支持他们的事业。他们只担心副军事长官卢的反对。

反叛者武器弹药短缺，因此他们正试图收买警察，以便在进攻兵工厂时协助他们。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

（批注：...）
警务处总监。
